attackers_goals: Usage of the Kubernetes API server to perform operations inside the cluster.
description: A combination of signals has been detected indicating that kubelet credentials were used inside a pod to access the Kubernetes API. This activity suggests an attempt to escalate privileges or move laterally within the cluster.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Exfiltration, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check if there is an active attack against the Kubernetes cluster.
name: Suspicious access to Kubernetes API with kubelet credentials
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
